statement: The function returns a result r, and r equals the minimum of Σ_{t=0}^{k-1} C(a_t) over all choices of k integers a_0,...,a_{k-1} such that 0 <= a_0, a_{t+1} >= a_t + x for every 0 <= t < k-1, and a_{k-1} + x <= len(nums), where for each integer i with 0 <= i <= len(nums)-x, C(i) = min { Σ_{j=0}^{x-1} |nums[i+j] - v| : v ∈ ℤ }.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, overflow, or panic.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 0.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= 2000000 * k * x.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = 0 if and only if there exist k integers a_0,...,a_{k-1} such that 0 <= a_0, a_{t+1} >= a_t + x for every t with 0 <= t < k-1, a_{k-1} + x <= len(nums), and for every t with 0 <= t < k and every j with 0 <= j < x, nums[a_t+j] = nums[a_t].
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: If min_operations(nums,x,k) returns r and min_operations(nums',x,k) returns r', then r = r'.
preconditions: nums and nums' are slices of i64 with the same length n; nums and nums' both satisfy 2 <= n <= 100000 and all their entries lie in [-1000000,1000000]; 2 <= x <= n; 1 <= k <= 15; 2 <= k*x <= n; and there is an integer c such that nums'[i] = nums[i] + c for every 0 <= i < n, with every nums'[i] still in the i64 range.

statement: If min_operations(nums,x,k1) returns r1 and min_operations(nums,x,k2) returns r2, then r1 <= r2.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; every nums[i] lies in [-1000000,1000000]; 2 <= x <= len(nums); and integers k1,k2 satisfy 1 <= k1 <= k2 <= 15 and 2 <= k2*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every choice of integers a_0,...,a_{k-1} with 0 <= a_0, a_{t+1} >= a_t + x for all 0 <= t < k-1, and a_{k-1}+x <= len(nums), we have r <= Σ_{t=0}^{k-1} C(a_t), where C(i) = min { Σ_{j=0}^{x-1} |nums[i+j]-v| : v ∈ ℤ }.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 2 and 100000 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000; 2 <= x <= len(nums); 1 <= k <= 15; and 2 <= k*x <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r, and there exist integers a_0,...,a_{k-1} with 0 <= a_0, a_{t+1} >= a_t + x for all 0 <= t < k-1, and a_{k-1}+x <= len(nums) such that r = Σ_{t=0}^{k-1} C(a_t), where C(i) = min { Σ_{j=0}^{x-1} |nums[i+j]-v| : v ∈ ℤ }.
